Bash(powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "
Import-Module PnP.PowerShell -ErrorAction Stop
$SiteUrl = ''https://gslelectric8540.sharepoint.com/sites/StandardOperationProcedures''
$LibraryName = ''Standard Operating Procedures''

Write-Host ''=== CONNECTING TO SHAREPOINT ==='' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Connect-PnPOnline -Url $SiteUrl -UseWebLogin

$files = @\(
    ''C:\\Users\\tewing\\Desktop\\Holding\\SOP\\Revised-SOPs\\9.2.010 – Team Selection.docx'',
    ''C:\\Users\\tewing\\Desktop\\Holding\\SOP\\Revised-SOPs\\9.2.015 – Project Turnover Meeting.docx'',
    ''C:\\Users\\tewing\\Desktop\\Holding\\SOP\\Revised-SOPs\\9.4.360 – Manage Change Orders.docx''
\)

Write-Host ''=== UPLOADING 3 SAMPLE SOPs ==='' -ForegroundColor Cyan
foreach \($file in $files\) {
    $name = Split-Path $file -Leaf
    try {
        Add-PnPFile -Path $file -Folder $LibraryName -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
        Write-Host ""  [OK] $name"" -ForegroundColor Green
    } catch {
        Write-Host ""  [FAILED] $name - $_"" -ForegroundColor Red
    }
}

Write-Host ''=== COMPLETE ==='' -ForegroundColor Green
")
